observations: A used automatic transmission housing (gearbox) is shown on a concrete floor.
The housing is dirty, dusty, and has some surface rust.
A metal bracket with a 'VINCO AUTO SPARE PARTS' watermark is visible on both photos.
No Lexus brand markings, model labels, or identification plates are visible on the housing in the photos.
The item appears to be a used or second-hand part.

claims.evidence: No Lexus branding or model identification plate is visible in the photos.
No origin markings or 'Japan' labels are visible on the housing.
No pin count or connector type is visible in the photos.
No manufacturing or production dates are visible on the housing.
A guarantee is a promise of service, not a physical item.
Strength is a subjective mechanical property not visible in photos.
Affordability is a subjective market value not visible in photos.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or third-party part rather than a genuine Lexus part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's label or identification plate on the housing.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be used, rebuilt, or have internal mechanical damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the gearbox being tested or a close-up of the internal gears.
risks.if_unproven: as used and requiring professional repair

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing essential components like the clutch or transmission fluid reservoir.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete transmission assembly with all components.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare gearbox missing clutch and fluid tank

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the gearbox.
Photo of the clutch and fluid reservoir if they are included in the sale.
Video of the gearbox being tested or a clear photo of the internal gears.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
